attempt: One CLI session requested four separate 1536x1024 white-background 2x2 sprite sheets; a later one-image noninteractive retry isolated CLI startup.
outcome: The first session produced no response or file after about 9 minutes and was interrupted. The one-image retry exited 1 before image_gen: failed to initialize in-process app-server client: Operation not permitted (os error 1).
generation_note: Four selected candidates were produced by make_sources.py with Pillow as the repository's documented deterministic fallback. They are not image-model output.
